description: A sample and hold feeding an eight-stage shift register: each trigger moves every held voltage on one stage

inputs.text: The voltage sampled into the first stage on each trigger
A rising edge moves every held voltage on one stage and samples the input into the first stage

outputs.text: The voltage held in that stage of the register

menu: Reset on start — clears the stored voltages when the patch is loaded, rather than restoring the ones saved with it
